unsupported: Carparts Distribution Center, operating as Carparts of Pepperell among other locations, traces its roots to 1975 when it began as a locally owned automotive parts supplier in southern New Hampshire.
Ownership has remained local and private since founding, though the original founders are not named in public records.
The business functions as a full-line automotive parts distributor, stocking replacement components for passenger cars, light trucks, and heavy-duty applications through its Auto Value affiliation.

Its network includes 21 storefronts — branded variously as Carparts of [Town], Motor Supply (a division with eight Maine locations), and Steve's Auto Parts — supported by a central distribution center.
Primary customers are independent repair shops, fleet maintenance operations, and do-it-yourself vehicle owners throughout northern New England.

The Motor Supply division specifically targets heavy-duty and commercial truck repair in central Maine, while the Carparts-branded locations serve the broader light-vehicle aftermarket across the three-state footprint.
